runs.limits: Pure TypeScript/React logic under node. No device, simulator or emulator executed. JVM (Kotlin) and Swift native-module tests not run on this host (no Java runtime / Android SDK; no iOS toolchain on Windows); those modules do not touch Operations.

checks.detail: workspace.operations requires OPERATIONS_VIEW, requiredActiveSpace PERSONAL_OR_ORG, HIDDEN_IF_NO_CAPABILITY (hidden, not chipped, when missing); excluded from provisional nav before the envelope arrives. Label 'Operations' has no labelKey (untranslated).

resolveOperationsAccess mirrors web resolveRuntimeReadAccess (no_envelope/no_workspace/workspace not active/context_mismatch/account_not_active/OPERATIONS_VIEW). Restricted renders copy and issues NO /v1/ops call (asserted in ops-parity test). Web equivalent apps/web/app/(app)/operations/page.tsx:399.

OPERATIONS_ACKNOWLEDGE/RESOLVE/SUPPRESS/ASSIGN/SAVED_VIEWS_MANAGE from envelope; rowEligibility adds status (ack only OPEN; resolve needs manualResolution && live; suppress/assign need OPEN|ACKNOWLEDGED). Selection checkboxes only if acknowledge||suppress. WORKSPACE_HEALTH_VIEW gates the health link (ops-console.ts:1163-1165, index.tsx:476).

usePlatformContext is a per-instance fetch (no shared store/subscription); switching on the Spaces screen refreshes only that instance, so a mounted Operations screen keeps its old teamId until remount. If teamId does change in-instance, reads re-run (teamId in effect deps) but filters, marked (bulk selection), openId/openGroup, views and incidents are NOT reset; phase stays 'ready' so prior-workspace rows stay visible during the re-read and a bulk action could send prior-workspace ids with the new teamId. No test covers this.

summary, incidents (cursor, 50/page, 'Load 50 more' appends) and groups (default grouped view) read in parallel; 250ms debounced search; loading is not empty (groups loading shows a spinner); failed incidents read -> unavailable state with support reference + Try again; Refresh shows 'Refreshing…' and is disabled meanwhile.

Bottom-sheet inspector reads /v1/ops/incidents/:id; renders the queue row immediately and keeps it if history fails; sections What happened, What you can do (server remediation actions w/ confirm + required reason), How much, When/SLA, Ownership (collaborative only), History, Technical references (copyable), lifecycle buttons.

Incident: relatedEvidenceId -> /evidence/<id> ('Open record'); job/provider -> label only, no link. Group affected rows -> /evidence/<evidenceId>. Remediation deepLink href is pushed verbatim from the server (no allow-list). Same targets as web (_lib/rowModel.ts:160, _components/GroupInspector.tsx:301, _components/IncidentInspector.tsx:408).

Forbidden actions are hidden (not disabled). Row menu absent when no action applies. Bulk assign only when collaborative && assign && operators. Saved-view manage only for the owner, or SAVED_VIEWS_MANAGE for TEAM views. Suppress has no confirmation on either native or web.

summary/incidents/groups/incident-detail effects use a `live` flag. NOT guarded: assignable-operators fetch, saved-views load, loadMore (appends a page read under old filters/team after await), reconcile poll loop (continues after unmount and writes summary), GroupInspector load. No AbortController anywhere.

toSafeUserError -> safe message + requestId support reference. Lifecycle refusal codes CONDITION_STILL_ACTIVE / CONDITION_ACTIVITY_UNKNOWN / CONDITION_NOT_DIRECTLY_RESOLVABLE -> confirm sheet. Bulk uses step-up challenge and treats STEP_UP_CANCEL as an outcome. Remediation refusal shows server remediation.message (web shows generic copy, ops-console.ts:26-27). Failed grouped read is shown as a failure; web swallows it and sets groups [] (apps/web/app/(app)/operations/page.tsx:455-461).

No NetInfo dependency. Global offline banner derived from transport failures only ('showing the latest available data'). Ops screen has no offline-specific state, no cache, no auto-retry on reconnect; a failed read shows the generic unavailable state.

checks.detail: Mobile has i18n (shared dict, 7 locales; device locale via NativeModules.I18nManager.localeIdentifier / SettingsManager) but the ops screen uses NO t(); all copy is hard-coded English; numbers use toLocaleString('en-US'). No I18nManager.forceRTL/allowRTL; RTL is per-component (isRTL = locale 'ar' flips text alignment/writingDirection and section headers), so Arabic users get English ops copy right-aligned.

Severity capsule, selection checkbox (role + checked state), row/group buttons, actions menu, notices (role alert), copy buttons and inputs are labelled. Filter chips/KPI cards rely on shared primitives; no live announcement for bulk outcome or refresh completion; labels English-only.

checks.check: Native vs web vs API action set
checks.detail: Native = web /operations page set: summary, incidents, incident-groups(+affected), incident detail, ack/resolve/suppress, assign, remediate, assignable-operators, saved-views CRUD, workspace-reconcile, bulk-actions (ACK/SUPPRESS/ASSIGN_INCIDENTS). Native exposes nothing the web page lacks. Native has no screen for web subpages /operations/analytics, /automation, /reliability (native-destinations.mjs:561-605 lists only /operations, /health, /batch-analysis, /quotas). API endpoints used by neither console page: /v1/ops/workflows* (assign/start/escalate/mitigation/resolve/suppress/reopen/schedule-retry), /causality/chains*, /alerts, /reconcile, /bulk-actions/:id, media-intelligence runs/retry/dismiss/dlq, upload-telemetry, and bulk types BULK_*_WORKFLOWS/SCHEDULE_RETRY/ADD_MITIGATION/DISMISS_RECOMMENDATIONS (ops.routes.ts:2929-2937). Refusal copy says 'suppress it with a recorded reason' but suppress body is TeamIdOnly (ops.routes.ts:1743) and neither client sends a reason.

Server item statuses PENDING/COMPLETED/SKIPPED/FAILED; run status COMPLETED/PARTIAL_FAILED/FAILED. Native counts COMPLETED as success, SKIPPED as 'needed no change', unreported ids stay selected. Web counts items !== 'SUCCEEDED' as failed, a value the server never emits, so every web bulk run reports '0 of N updated' and keeps all rows selected.

nativeModules.note: No apps/mobile/android or apps/mobile/ios directories (Expo CNG). No native module or native test touches Operations.
